punchline: The day after his daughter was born, McKeown left the hospital for a client meeting that turned out not to matter.
thirty_sec: Greg McKeown's daughter was born the day before. He's at the hospital, still answering work e-mails, when a colleague asks him to come to a client meeting. He goes, expecting respect. Instead the client seems to think less of him, and the meeting turns out to be unimportant. His takeaway: if you don't prioritize your life, someone else will. So he uses the 90 percent rule.
